policy: Every long-tail method reviewed by swarmstr-u6gn.8 is pinned as implemented, intentionally divergent, or deferred to a dedicated bead. Methods in the latter two states must not be advertised by Metiq.

implemented.semantics: Preferences are caller-scoped to the authenticated Nostr pubkey, use bounded PATCH semantics, and persist in the versioned user-profile ledger. Role metadata is durable, nullable, and restricted to configured gateway.roles definitions.

CRUD is backed only by a ProtectedSecretBackend and produces structured store SecretRefs. Secret-kind values are never listed; env-kind values follow the upstream list contract. All three methods are authenticated WebSocket/internal-only and non-replayable so values cannot enter Nostr events or durable response caches.

deferred.rationale: Needs durable goal lifecycle state, mutation fences, receipts, and resume integration; SessionDoc metadata alone would be a partial implementation.
Current state has aggregate counters and last-turn data, not the durable per-turn history required for honest timeseries and logs.
Existing proposal CRUD/history does not provide upstream event-history and evaluation semantics.
The global hook manager list is not equivalent to the upstream per-agent workspace/plugin live report.
Existing permission audit list/activity lacks durable run-scoped correlation.
Metiq needs a deliberate runtime lane model; unrelated task/job counters must not be presented as lane state.

intentional_divergences.rationale: Metiq has no browser-push service, VAPID key lifecycle, or push subscription store; notifications flow through Nostr/channel events.
Metiq does not own GitHub OAuth, hosted project search, or a GitHub publication lifecycle; repositories and worktrees are operator-managed.
Metiq is a daemon and has no OpenClaw desktop worker host/process model.
There is no portal process/window lifecycle in Metiq.
Metiq exposes durable tasks and lifecycle gateway events instead of an OpenClaw progress-card projection.
These bind to OpenClaw's Control UI and GitHub preview model; Metiq has its own Web UI, board, artifact, and worktree surfaces.
Metiq authenticates with Nostr identities/device pairing and invokes its internal hook manager directly; it has no web-login or native-hook relay RPC.
WebSocket connection establishment is a transport handshake, not an RPC. chat.inject bypasses authenticated Nostr/session ingress and violates Metiq's event-driven routing contract.
Opening a host editor is a UI/OS side effect; Metiq already exposes config get/set/apply/patch/schema surfaces.
